name: std::unique_ptr<T,Deleter>::~unique_ptr
intro:
If get() == nullptr there are no effects. Otherwise, the owned object is destroyed via get_deleter()(get()).

Requires that get_deleter()(get()) does not throw exceptions.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Although std::unique_ptr<T> with the default deleter may be constructed with incomplete type T, the type T must be complete at the point of code where the destructor is called.
